Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great to hear more about Clearbridge's rollout plans. Per our call, attaching the SIG starter pack so your security team can kick off the vendor assessment. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- I attached the SIG initiation PDF (short form) to give you our answers to the high-level items we discussed.
- Can you confirm the primary contact on your side for the questionnaire (security reviewer vs procurement)? I put procurement on Cc for visibility.
- A couple of clarifying questions for your security team (listed below) that will help us speed up the answers: 
  1) For SOC 2 — do you need our full Type II report or will a SOC 2 Type I + bridge letter do for now?
  2) For data residency — are you evaluating EU-only data storage for PII, or is US-based processing acceptable for this workload?
  3) Any preferred format for the SIG responses (native SIG CSV/Excel, or can we share a PDF)?

Proposed timeline: we can return a completed SIG CSV within 3 business days once we have the security contact confirmed and the questions below answered.

Attachment: [SIG-Initiation-Clearbridge-Health.pdf (application/pdf, 3 pages)]

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa from our security team on any technical clarifications.

Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearbridgehealth.com, procurement@clearbridgehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire - Clearbridge Health (next steps / clarifying Qs)

Camila — thanks, this is helpful. A few quick notes from our side: 

Thanks for sending. Security is copied (security@clearbridgehealth.com) — please loop in anyone technical as needed. A couple clarifications on your questions: 

- SOC 2: Our procurement team prefers a full SOC 2 Type II report for production vendors that will process PHI. Our security lead noted that a Type I + bridge letter could be accepted for pilots, but since we plan to go live next quarter, Type II is preferred. Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 status and earliest availability for a Type II report?

- Data residency: For the initial rollout we need US-only processing. EU residency is not required for this phase.

- SIG format: security@ prefers the native SIG spreadsheet (CSV/Excel) so they can import into their vendor portal. PDF is fine for exec review but not for intake.

Also, security asked two initial technical clarifying questions they wanted captured before we route the SIG to them: 
  a) Does Redwood support AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.2+ for data in transit?
  b) Do you have an option for customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Private deployments, or is that only for Dedicated instances?

If you can answer those and confirm SOC 2 status, we’ll create a HubSpot task and route the SIG to security for the full review.

Best,
Alex
Director of IT Security, Clearbridge Health
alex.johnson@clearbridgehealth.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, procurement@clearbridgehealth.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire - Clearbridge Health (next steps / clarifying Qs)

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick response and for looping in security. Answers below — I also attached our SIG CSV template pre-filled with high-level answers where possible to speed the intake. Marissa (security) is on Cc to confirm technical items.

Answers: 
- SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in-scope and our latest report covers our hosted API and dedicated offering. We can share the Type II report under an NDA / via secure upload. Earliest shareable copy: within 2 business days once we execute the mutual NDA. For pilots, we can also provide a summary + bridge letter immediately.

- Data residency: US-only processing is supported for your rollout. We can pin the deployment region to US-West (or an alternative region if you prefer) for the affected environment.

- SIG format: we’ll provide the native SIG Excel/CSV — attaching the completed starter sheet.

Technical answers (from Marissa): 
  1) AES-256 is used for data at rest across our hosted and dedicated offerings. Traffic is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2+ (we are TLS 1.3-capable across our stack).
  2) Customer-managed keys: supported in Private deployments (customer KMS/HSM integration). For Redwood Dedicated we offer encryption at rest with provider-managed keys; dedicated customers can request a Bring-Your-Own-Key option in certain enterprise contracts — Marissa can follow up with more details on the process and limitations.

Attachment: [SIG-Initiation-Clearbridge-Health.csv (text/csv, 1 sheet)]

Next steps: if this aligns, Alex — can you confirm the security reviewer name and preferred secure upload method (SharePoint / SFTP / secure portal)? Once we have that, I’ll send the full SIG and SOC2 access instructions.

Thanks,
Camila

---
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearbridgehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire - Clearbridge Health (next steps / clarifying Qs)

Alex / Camila — quick follow-up from security:

- Confirmed: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 preferred (we maintain TLS 1.2 minimum).
- KMS specifics: for Private we support customer KMS via AWS KMS / GCP KMS integrations and we can support HSM in air-gapped/on-prem packages. For Dedicated, BYOK is available under an enterprise addendum; it requires a short onboarding window and key escrow options if required.
- SOC 2 delivery: we will share the Type II report via a secure upload link once the standard Redwood mutual NDA is signed. If procurement would like an interim artifact, we can provide a redacted summary and bridge letter now.

Camila — I uploaded the starter SIG CSV and the redacted SOC2 summary to the SIG tracker (link below). Alex — procurement/security, let us know which upload route you prefer and we’ll move the full package there.

Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3cSIG-tracker
